\section{Initial Space}
\label{sec:initial}

\begin{thm}[Compactness criterion]
\label{thm:compactness}
Bounded sets in weighted Sobolev space embed compactly into square-integrable functions.
\end{thm}

\section{Closure Property}
\label{sec:closure}

\begin{lem}[Norm equivalence]
\label{lem:equiv}
The graph norm is equivalent to the weighted Sobolev norm on the domain core.
\end{lem}

\begin{prop}[Closed range]
\label{prop:closed-range}
Zero lies outside the essential spectrum of the shifted elliptic operator.
\end{prop}
